newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malacca state eyes Malaysia Aica -paper.
newsitem.headline: Malacca state eyes Malaysia Aica -paper.

text.p: The government of central Malacca state is negotiating a deal with Malaysia Aica Bhd which could result in a reverse takeover of the company, The Star newspaper said on Thursday.
Quoting sources from the company and the Malacca government, the daily said there was a possibility that projects could be injected into Aica, currently an industrial products maker.

"The discussions are with (Aica chairman) Robert Tan...we are not sure of the projects which will be injected into the listed vehicle for the reverse takeover," a Malacca official was quoted as saying.
